title: The key points past the marked road
body: The map is folded toward its road line; the keyring lies beyond the fold, its tag turned face down. A short length of thread joins them but does not reach the road.
rival_reading: A delayed farm delivery could leave a key and map where someone stopped; the route alone does not show a failed evacuation.
gloss: A key and route remain connected only by a short thread.

title: The note that asks someone to come back
body: “Forget the box. Just get here before the rows are watered.” The lower half is torn away; a muddy thumb has blurred the place where a name would go.
rival_reading: An emergency crew could tell someone to reach a farm before irrigation resumed; the urgency could follow a road closure rather than a program failure.
gloss: A hurried request links an unnamed person to watered rows.
